title: 第十七章 密林截杀半步武徒镇群妖第十八章 古林核心玄水灵泉孕武徒
lines: 破晓天光穿破层层林翳，细碎金辉洒落黑风古林，驱散了整夜笼罩山野的浓稠幽暗。
林间夜风渐歇，阴冷浊气被晨光涤荡，只剩下草木清新与淡淡的妖兽血腥交织的气息，弥漫在整片山林之间。
沈砚踏步前行，身姿挺拔如松，步履沉稳轻盈。
淬体七重圆满的修为彻底稳固，肉身筋骨无瑕、气血浑厚充盈，每一寸肌理都蕴藏着极致的爆发力。一夜血战苦修、灵药淬骨、妖兽炼体，早已让他脱胎换骨，如今的他，已然站在淬体境的最巅峰，距离武徒境界，仅有一步之遥。
武徒，淬体之上的全新门槛，是真正脱离凡人肉身、踏入正统武道的第一道分水岭。
寻常武者，穷尽数年苦修、无数丹药滋养，尚且未必能顺利踏足武徒，可对沈砚而言，七重圆满的扎实根基、无数生死厮杀沉淀的底蕴，早已足够支撑他冲击壁垒，只差最后一丝积累与契机。
幽谷后方，山林地貌彻底变换。
相较于外围的荆棘丛生、地势平缓，黑风古林中层区域，古木更为参天，山势愈发陡峭，怪石嶙峋、沟壑纵横，密林层层叠叠，遮蔽大半天光，空气中的蛮荒肃杀之气，较之外围浓郁数倍不止。
这里是真正的妖兽领地，是人迹罕至的凶险绝地。
外围偶尔能见到的散修、猎妖武者，在此彻底绝迹，放眼望去，只有纵横交错的古树、遍布山野的兽痕，以及此起彼伏、愈发凶悍的妖兽咆哮。
越往深处，妖兽的气息便愈发强横，最低皆是淬体七重层次，无数八重妖兽盘踞一方，各自划分领地、相互制衡，凶险程度呈几何倍数暴涨。
“古林中层，灵气更浓、妖兽更强，正好用来打磨气血、积累底蕴，冲击半步武徒。”
沈砚抬眼扫视四周，眸底没有半分畏惧，只剩浓烈的战意与笃定。
淬体七重圆满，已是当前境界极致，再单纯打磨肉身、厮杀同级妖兽，提升已然微乎其微。想要百尺竿头更进一步，触摸武徒门槛，就必须持续压榨极限、血战更强对手，以极致压力催生境界蜕变。
半步武徒，便是淬体与武徒之间的过渡境界。
踏出这一步，气血凝练成形、肉身超凡脱俗，战力将彻底碾压所有淬体武者，哪怕面对真正的初阶武徒，也有足够的自保与抗衡之力。
这便是他接下来的目标。
沈砚敛息凝神，五感全开，周身气息尽数内敛，融入周遭山林气息之中，身形如一抹青影，在密林怪石之间穿梭掠行。
他不刻意寻妖厮杀，也不盲目搜寻灵草机缘，只稳步纵深，一边熟悉中层山林地形，一边适应七重圆满的暴涨战力，将浑身过剩的力量，一点点打磨得愈发凝练、收放自如。
突破圆满之后，他的力量、速度、反应、感知全方位跃升，一身战力磅礴浩瀚，若是无法完美掌控，便会流于虚浮、难以极致发力。
武道修行，打磨境界易，掌控力量难。
无数天才武者，卡在境界虚浮、力量失控，最终根基崩坏、前路尽废。沈砚历经无数绝境，深知根基稳固、力量纯粹的重要性，故而不急着突破，先磨掌控、再积底蕴。
前行数百丈，周遭林木骤然稀疏，一片开阔的乱石坡出现在眼前。
乱石遍地、巨石林立，地面沟壑交错，无数深浅不一的爪痕、牙印布满岩石，空气中弥漫着一股凶悍暴戾的妖兽气息，煞气沉沉、威压逼人。
嗷呜——！
一声狂暴的兽吼骤然炸响，震动林间气流！
三道通体赤红、鬃毛张扬、体型壮硕的烈焰鬃狮，猛地从巨石后方窜扑而出，呈三角之势，瞬间封死沈砚所有进退路线。
烈焰鬃狮，黑风古林中层的群居妖兽，性情狂暴、嗜血好杀，周身自带微薄火劲，爪牙锋利、爆发力极强。单头成年烈焰鬃狮，战力堪比淬体八重初期，三头联手，默契十足、攻势叠加，足以正面碾压普通八重巅峰武者。
显然，这片乱石坡，便是三头烈焰鬃狮的盘踞领地。沈砚贸然踏入，瞬间激怒了领地凶兽。
三头雄狮双目赤红、凶光毕露，大口开合之间，喷出缕缕灼热白气，周身鬃毛根根倒竖，裹挟淡淡的火劲，凶悍的威压死死锁定沈砚，蓄势待发、随时扑杀。
“三头八重妖兽，正好用来磨砺战力、凝练气血。”
沈砚驻足原地，神色淡然无波，眼底反倒燃起一抹浓烈战意。
先前斩杀的黑风水蟒，虽同为八重初期，却擅长防御伏击、正面爆发力偏弱。而这三头烈焰鬃狮，主攻强攻、爆发力凶悍、联手默契，正好能逼迫他全力出手，压榨自身极限。
吼！
无需多余试探，最左侧的烈焰鬃狮率先发难！
庞大身躯猛然弹射而出，四蹄蹬地、碎石飞溅，裹挟着灼热劲风与狂暴杀气，巨口大张，獠牙寒光闪烁，径直朝着沈砚头颅狠狠撕咬而来，攻势霸道迅猛、悍然无匹。
沈砚不慌不忙，流云碎月步轻踏而出，身形飘忽侧移，精准避开这致命一扑。
同时右手五指紧握，气血尽数汇聚拳锋，碎石诀全力催动，凝练出刚猛厚重的霸道拳劲，顺势反轰而出！
砰！
拳劲轰鸣，精准砸在雄狮侧身软肋！
雄浑磅礴的巨力瞬间炸开，坚硬的狮毛、厚实的皮肉应声崩裂，鲜血飞溅。
那头烈焰鬃狮庞大身躯剧烈一颤，发出一声痛苦的闷吼，庞大身躯踉跄倒飞，重重撞在后方巨石之上，巨石瞬间开裂蛛网纹路。
一招重创一头八重妖兽！
剩余两头雄狮见状，愈发暴怒，双双嘶吼着同步扑杀而至！
content_en:
The light of dawn breaks through the layers of forest, and the fine golden light shines on the ancient black wind forest, dispelling the thick darkness that shrouded the mountains and fields all night long.
The night wind in the forest gradually subsided, and the cold and turbid air was washed away by the morning light, leaving only the smell of fresh vegetation and a touch of blood of monsters and beasts, permeating the entire mountain forest.
Shen Yan stepped forward, his posture as tall and straight as a pine tree, and his steps were steady and light.
The cultivation of the seventh level of body tempering is completely stable, the muscles and bones of the body are flawless, the qi and blood are thick and full, and every inch of the texture contains the ultimate explosive power. A night of hard training in bloody battles, bone tempering with elixirs, and body refining with monsters and beasts had already transformed him. Now, he stands at the pinnacle of the body tempering realm, only one step away from the martial arts realm.
Martial disciple, a new threshold above the tempered body, is the first watershed to truly leave the mortal body and step into the orthodox martial arts.
Ordinary warriors may not be able to successfully become a martial artist after years of hard training and nourishment with countless elixirs. But for Shen Yan, the solid foundation of the seventh level of perfection and the accumulation of countless life-and-death battles are already enough to support him in breaking through the barriers, leaving only the last trace of accumulation and opportunity.
Behind the valley, the mountain and forest landscape has completely changed.
Compared with the thorny surroundings and gentle terrain, the middle area of ​​the Black Wind Ancient Forest has more towering ancient trees, steeper mountains, rugged rocks, criss-crossed ravines, and layers of dense forests that block most of the sky. The brutal and chilling atmosphere in the air is several times stronger than that in the outer areas.
This is the real territory of monsters, a dangerous and inaccessible place.
The casual cultivators and monster-hunting warriors that could occasionally be seen in the periphery were completely extinct here. Looking around, there were only criss-crossing ancient trees, beast marks all over the mountains and fields, and the roars of monster beasts that kept getting more and more fierce.
The deeper you go, the more powerful the auras of the monsters become. The lowest level is the seventh level of body tempering. Countless eighth-level monsters are entrenched on one side, each dividing their territory and balancing each other. The degree of danger increases exponentially.
"The middle level of the ancient forest has denser spiritual energy and stronger monsters. It is just used to polish the energy and blood, accumulate foundation, and attack the half-step warriors."
Shen Yan raised his eyes and glanced around. There was no fear in his eyes, only a strong fighting spirit and determination.
The seventh level of body tempering is perfect, which is the ultimate state of the current state. If you simply polish your body and kill monsters of the same level, your improvement will be minimal. If you want to make further progress and touch the threshold of martial arts, you must continue to squeeze your limits, fight bloody battles with stronger opponents, and use extreme pressure to induce state transformation.
Half-step martial arts is the transitional state between body tempering and martial arts.
Taking this step, the energy and blood will be condensed and formed, the body will be extraordinary, and the combat power will completely crush all the body-tempering warriors. Even if they face the real junior warriors, they will have enough power to protect themselves and compete.
This is his next goal.
Shen Yan held his breath and concentrated, with all five senses fully open. The aura around his body was all restrained, blending into the aura of the surrounding mountains and forests. His body was like a blue shadow, moving between the strange rocks in the dense forest.
He did not deliberately hunt for monsters to fight, nor did he blindly search for spiritual grass opportunities. He only steadily deepened, familiar with the terrain of the middle mountain forest, while adapting to the skyrocketing combat power of the seventh level of perfection, and polished the excess power in his body bit by bit to become more condensed and freely retractable.
After the breakthrough is complete, his strength, speed, reaction, and perception will all increase, and his combat power will be majestic. If he cannot control it perfectly, he will be in vain and unable to exert his full strength.
In martial arts practice, it is easy to polish one's realm, but difficult to control one's power.
Countless talented warriors are stuck in a vain state, their power is out of control, and eventually their foundations collapse and their future is ruined. Shen Yan has experienced countless desperate situations and knows the importance of a solid foundation and pure strength. Therefore, he is not in a hurry to break through, but first exercises control and then accumulates foundation.
After walking a few hundred feet, the surrounding trees suddenly became sparse, and an open rocky slope appeared in front of them.
There are rocks everywhere, huge boulders, and ravines on the ground. Countless claw marks and tooth marks of different shades are covered in the rocks. The air is filled with a fierce and violent aura of monsters, which is heavy and oppressive.
Ouch——!
A violent beast roar suddenly exploded, shaking the airflow in the forest!
Three flame-maned lions with red bodies, fluttering manes, and strong bodies suddenly rushed out from behind the boulder, forming a triangle and instantly blocking all Shen Yan's advance and retreat routes.
The flame-maned lion is a gregarious monster beast in the middle of the Black Wind Ancient Forest. It is violent, bloodthirsty and easy to kill. It has a small amount of fire power all over its body, sharp claws and extremely explosive power. The combat power of a single adult flame-maned lion is comparable to that of the early stage of the eighth level of body tempering. The three heads work together, with full tacit understanding and superimposed attacks, which is enough to crush ordinary eighth level peak warriors head-on.
Obviously, this rocky slope is the territory of three flame-maned lions. Shen Yan stepped in rashly, instantly angering the territorial beast.
The three male lions' eyes were red and fierce, and when they opened and closed their large mouths, they sprayed out wisps of scorching white air. The manes all over their bodies stood upright, carrying a touch of fire. They locked onto Shen Yan with fierce pressure, ready to attack at any time.
"The three-headed eight-level monsters are just right for sharpening combat power and condensing Qi and blood."
Shen Yan stopped where he was, with a calm expression, but a strong fighting spirit ignited in his eyes.
The black wind anaconda killed earlier was both at the early stage of the eighth level, but was good at defending against ambushes and had weak frontal explosive power. And these three flame-maned lions, who specialize in strong attacks, are explosive and fierce, and work together tacitly, can just force him to attack with all his strength and squeeze his limits.
roar!
No need for unnecessary testing, the flame-maned lion on the far left takes the lead in attacking!
The huge body suddenly ejected, with four hooves kicking on the ground, gravel flying, carrying scorching wind and violent murderous intent, its huge mouth opened wide, its fangs flashed with cold light, and it bit directly towards Shen Yan's head, the attack was domineering, fast, and unparalleled.
Shen Yan was calm and unhurried, stepping out with Liuyun breaking moon steps, his body moved sideways, and he accurately avoided this fatal attack.
At the same time, the five fingers of the right hand are clenched tightly, all the energy and blood are gathered at the fist edge, and the gravel technique is fully activated, condensing a strong and thick domineering punch.
title_en: Chapter 17: Intercepting and killing half-step warriors in the dense forest to suppress the group of demons Chapter 18: Pregnant warriors in the Xuanshui Lingquan at the core of the ancient forest
